prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1232; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented for evaluation following an injury sustained when struck while turning left. Examination revealed localized tenderness, swelling, and limited range of motion over the affected wrist. Radiographs demonstrated a distal radius fracture without significant displacement. The wrist was immobilized in a short arm splint and the patient was counseled on elevation, activity restriction, and use of over-the-counter analgesics as needed.

At the follow-up visit, alignment was re-assessed and remained stable. Swelling had decreased and the patient reported improved pain control. The splint was maintained, and a referral to hand therapy was arranged for progressive range-of-motion and strengthening exercises once immobilization is discontinued. Follow-up imaging is recommended to confirm continued healing. The patient was advised to return sooner for numbness, color change, or increasing pain.
